name: artifact-example-check
description: Use when maintaining schema examples for public harness artifacts.
trigger: A schema is added or changed and agents need a concrete valid example.
procedure: Create or update the matching example artifact.
Validate the example against the schema.
anti_rationalization: Do not assume prose examples are enough when a schema exists.
output_artifact: Valid JSON example artifact that matches the published schema and template contract.
failure_modes: Example adds fields not allowed by the closed schema.
